description: The arithmetic of paying a court fine or fee over time: give the amount owed and either a monthly payment or a number of months. Returns the number of payments, the last payment and the total. Courts set their own terms; this does not say what a court will accept.

monthly_income.description: Optional: monthly income, to show the payment as a share of it

monthly_payment.description: What can be paid each month, in dollars. Give this or months.

months.description: How many months to pay over. Give this or monthly_payment.

setup_fee.description: A one-time fee some courts add to a plan, in dollars

name: court_payment_plan
title: Work out a court payment plan
